info.title: Verana Graph API
info.description: Query layer of the Verana trust registry. Search and traversal per the v4 Verana Graph specification, ingested live from the indexer.

get.summary: Service health and the last applied block

post.summary: Search a surface (TG-FCT-3, ranked, trusted-only by default)
post.description:
Ranked search over one surface of the graph. Trusted-only by default (TG-FCT-3), pass includeUntrusted to widen.

**surface** (required): `Did`, `Ecosystem`, `Corporation`, `CredentialSchema`, `ServiceEndpoint`

**freeText**: ranked full-text match on the surface.

**filters**: object keyed by field. A bare scalar means equals, an array means any-of, or pass an operator object (`eq`, `in`, `prefix`, `range`, `contains`, `containsAny`). Fields on the Did surface: `Did.trusted`, `Did.pattern`, `Did.serviceTypes`, `Did.corporationId`, `Did.isCorporation`, `Did.isEcosystem`, `Did.ecosystemIds`, `Did.operatorKind`, `Did.operatorName`, `EcsCredential.ServiceCredential.type`, `EcsCredential.ServiceCredential.minimumAgeRequired`, `OrganizationCredential.countryCode`, `OrganizationCredential.legalJurisdiction`, `OrganizationCredential.organizationKind`, `OrganizationCredential.lei`, `OrganizationCredential.registryId`, `PersonaCredential.controllerCountryCode`, `PersonaCredential.controllerJurisdiction`, `Participant.ecosystemId`, `Participant.credentialSchemaId`, `Participant.role`. `Did.serviceTypes` and `Did.ecosystemIds` take `contains` or `containsAny` only. An unknown field returns `UNKNOWN_FILTER_FIELD`.

**facets**: the response carries one aggregation per `eq` or `in` filter in the request plus a default set per surface (TG-FCT-6). Did: `Did.operatorKind`, `EcsCredential.ServiceCredential.type`, `OrganizationCredential.countryCode`. Ecosystem: `archived`, `corporationId`. CredentialSchema: `archived`, `ecosystemId`. ServiceEndpoint: `type`. Corporation has none.

**snippet**: object of group name to boolean, checked against the queried surface (an unknown name or a group of another surface is `INVALID_INPUT`). Omit it for the default set, pass `{}` for the core alone (TG-FCT-6c). Every hit always carries the core of TG-FCT-6a: Did `did`, `lastObservedAtTime`, `isTrustExpired`, `trusted`, `isCorporation`, `isEcosystem`. Ecosystem `id`, `did`, `archived`, `lastObservedAtTime`. Corporation `id`, `did`, `lastObservedAtTime`. CredentialSchema `id`, `archived`, `lastObservedAtTime`. ServiceEndpoint `id`, `didId`, `type`, `serviceEndpoint`, `lastObservedAtTime`. Groups per surface (TG-FCT-6b), default set first, then opt-in. Did: `service`, `operator`, `corporation`, `endpoints`, then `ecosystems`, `participations`, `credentials`. Ecosystem: `corporation`, `stats`, `didCard`, then `governance`, `schemas`. Corporation: `trust`, `didCard`, then `governance`, `ecosystems`, `dids`. CredentialSchema: `schema`, `ecosystem`, then `stats`, `body`. ServiceEndpoint: `didCard`. List groups cap `entries` at 100, the counters next to them are never capped.

**limit**: 1..200, default 20. **cursor**: opaque keyset cursor from the previous page, `cursor` in the response is null on the last page (TG-FCT-7). The selector never changes the result set, so a cursor stays valid when `snippet` changes between pages.

schema.title: SearchRequest
schema.description: Request payload for the verana-graph faceted-search endpoint `POST /v4/graph/search` (per [TG-FCT-1] through [TG-FCT-7]). Filter field names use the dotted form from [TG-FCT-3] / [TG-FCT-4]. Filter values are either bare scalars (interpreted as `eq`) or operator objects (`{ eq | in | range | prefix | contains | containsAny }`). The optional `snippet` selector projects the queried surface's [TG-FCT-6b] field groups onto its hits per [TG-FCT-6c], validated per surface via the root `allOf` branches. Per [TG-FCT-7] pagination is cursor-based; offset-based pagination MUST NOT be used. See `### Search REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

surface.description: Searchable result surface per [TG-FCT-1]. Exactly one surface per request.

filters.description: Structured filters keyed by dotted field names from [TG-FCT-3] (e.g. `Did.operatorKind`, `OrganizationCredential.legalJurisdiction`, `Participant.role`). Each value MUST validate against `#/$defs/FilterValue`. Free-form because field names span multiple ECS schemas; per-surface field-name validity is documented in the spec, not enforced by this schema.

freeText.description: Free-form lexical query string. Scored against the fields enumerated in [TG-FCT-4], with the matching baseline of [TG-FCT-4a]: case-insensitive, whole-token (no implied substring matching; optional prefix matching on the final token), conjunctive across tokens (every token must match at least one scored field of the hit). Absent, empty, or whitespace-only means no lexical constraint (filters and gates only).

snippet.description: Snippet projection per [TG-FCT-6c]: keys are group names of the QUERIED surface's [TG-FCT-6b] catalogue, values are booleans. Enforced per surface by the root `allOf` branches below (a key from another surface's catalogue, or any unknown key, is INVALID_INPUT). When omitted, the surface's default set is returned (`Did`: service, operator, corporation, endpoints; `Ecosystem`: corporation, stats, didCard; `Corporation`: trust, didCard; `CredentialSchema`: schema, ecosystem; `ServiceEndpoint`: didCard). When present, exactly the groups set `true` are returned (plus the always-present [TG-FCT-6a] core); groups not set `true` are omitted from the snippet entirely, and `{}` returns the core alone.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return on this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response per [TG-FCT-7]. Omit (or set `null`) for the first page.

includeUntrusted.description: Override the [TG-FCT-2] default `Did.trusted = true` gate — on the `Did` surface, and on the `ServiceEndpoint` surface, whose hits mirror their owning DID's gates. No effect on other surfaces. The `Did.expiresAtTime` (null OR `>= now`) and trust-expired gates of [TG-FCT-2] are NOT overridable, regardless of this flag.

includeArchived.description: Override the [TG-FCT-2] default `archived = false` gate on `Ecosystem` and `CredentialSchema` surfaces. Has no effect on other surfaces.

snippetDid.summary: Pick the Did groups to return

200.description: Ranked hits, each with the TG-FCT-6a core plus the projected groups, keyset pagination

schema.title: SearchResponse
schema.description: Response envelope for the verana-graph faceted-search endpoint `POST /v4/graph/search` per [TG-FCT-6]. Each `hits[].snippet` MUST carry the per-surface core of [TG-FCT-6a]: the entity's primary key, `lastObservedAtTime`, the visibility flags applicable to the surface (`isTrustExpired` for `Did`, `archived` for `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`), the DID binding on DID-bound surfaces (`did` on `Did` / `Corporation` / `Ecosystem`, `didId` on `ServiceEndpoint`), the `Did`-surface flags `trusted` / `isCorporation` / `isEcosystem`, and `type` / `serviceEndpoint` on the `ServiceEndpoint` surface. Each snippet additionally carries the field groups of the queried surface's [TG-FCT-6b] catalogue selected by the request's `snippet` projection per [TG-FCT-6c] (per-surface default sets; an unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`). Implementations MAY surface additional per-card fields (additionalProperties open). Per [TG-FCT-7] the `cursor` field is opaque and is the only way to fetch subsequent pages. All datetime values are ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC strings (see `#/$defs/Iso8601DateTime`). See `### Search REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

query.description: Echo of the request payload (per [TG-FCT-6]). Validates against `request.schema.json`; not re-validated structurally here to avoid coupling response validation to request constraints.

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the filtered, gated query — not the size of `hits[]` (which is bounded by the request's `limit`).

hits.description: Page of ranked hits, ordered by descending `score`.

facets.description: Aggregations keyed by the queried surface's filter field names exactly as declared in [TG-FCT-3] (dotted on the `Did` surface, bare on the others) — identical to the keys the client uses in `filters`. Per [TG-FCT-6]: MUST contain an aggregation for every filter field referenced in the request's `filters` with an `eq` or `in` operator (bare scalars and arrays included — sugar for eq/in; prefix/range uses require none); SHOULD additionally carry an implementation-defined default set useful to the surface; near-unique-value fields (`lei`, `registryId`, `operatorName`) are never required beyond that rule.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page, or `null` when this is the last page. Per [TG-FCT-7] cursors MAY become invalid; subsequent calls with an invalid cursor MUST return an explicit error rather than silently re-anchoring.

schema.title: GraphErrorResponse
schema.description: Shared error envelope for the Verana Graph traversal and faceted-search APIs, per [TG-ERR-1]. Every non-2xx response of either API MUST validate against this schema.

code.description: Machine-readable error class per [TG-ERR-1] — the only field programmatic consumers need.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Implementation-defined wording; MUST NOT be required for programmatic dispatch.

post.description:
One endpoint, nineteen canonical queries (TG-QRY-3). Set `query` and give the matching `input`:

| query | returns | input (bold = required) |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | trust summary of a DID | **did** |
| A2 | governing chain: corporation + ecosystems | **did** |
| A3 | service endpoints | **did** |
| A4 | linked VPs and contained VTCs | **did** |
| A5 | credentials the DID holds | **did**, ecsSchema |
| A6 | credentials the DID issued | **did**, ecsSchema |
| A7 | participants of the DID by role | **did**, role |
| B1 | issuer recovery for a credential | **did**, **credentialId** |
| B2 | holder recovery for a credential | **did**, **credentialId** |
| C1 | schemas owned by an ecosystem | **ecosystemId** |
| C2 | participating DIDs grouped by role | **ecosystemId**, role, credentialSchemaId |
| C3 | ecosystem governance summary | **ecosystemId** |
| D1 | credentials based on a schema | **credentialSchemaId** |
| D2 | participating DIDs of a schema | **credentialSchemaId**, role |
| E1 | DIDs operated by a corporation | **corporationId** |
| E2 | ecosystems controlled by a corporation | **corporationId** |
| E3 | corporation governance summary | **corporationId** |
| F1 | path between two entities | **from**, **to** (EntityRef) |
| G1 | validator chain, root to leaf | **participantId** |

`role`: HOLDER, ISSUER, VERIFIER, ISSUER_GRANTOR, VERIFIER_GRANTOR, ECOSYSTEM. `ecsSchema`: ServiceCredential, OrganizationCredential, PersonaCredential, UserAgentCredential. `EntityRef`: `{type, id}` with type one of Did, Corporation, Ecosystem, CredentialSchema, Participant, EcsCredential, Vtc, LinkedVerifiablePresentation, ServiceEndpoint.

Collection queries take `limit` (1..500, default 100) and `cursor`. Non-ACTIVE participants appear in traversal with their true state while referenced (TG-ACT-1), search never returns them.

Errors (TG-ERR-1 envelope): `INVALID_INPUT`, `UNKNOWN_QUERY`, `UNKNOWN_ID`, `UNKNOWN_FILTER_FIELD`, `INVALID_CURSOR`.

schema.title: TraverseRequest
schema.description: Request payload for the verana-graph canonical traversal queries [TG-QRY-3]. The single endpoint `POST /v4/graph/traverse` dispatches on the `query` selector; the `input` shape is fixed per query. See `### Traversal REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

input.description: Per-query input shape; constrained by the discriminated `allOf` branch matching `query`.

limit.description: Page size for the paginated queries of [TG-QRY-6] (A4–A7, C1–C2, D1–D2, E1–E2). Ignored by shape-fixed queries.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, per [TG-QRY-6] / [TG-FCT-7]. Malformed or query-mismatched cursors yield the INVALID_CURSOR error of [TG-ERR-1].

trustSummary.summary: A1 trust summary of a verified service

participantsByRole.summary: A7 participants of a DID, paginated

validatorChain.summary: G1 validator chain, crosses a retained REVOKED participant

schema.title: TraverseResponse
schema.description: Response payload for the verana-graph canonical traversal queries [TG-QRY-3]. The single endpoint `POST /v4/graph/traverse` returns a per-query `output` shape mirroring the **Output (shape)** column of the [TG-QRY-3] tables. Every entity reference carries its primary key, `lastObservedAtTime`, and the visibility flags applicable to its type (`isTrustExpired` for `Did`, `archived` for `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`). All datetime values are ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC strings (see `#/$defs/Iso8601DateTime`). See `### Traversal REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

evaluatedAtTime.description: Wall-clock evaluation time of the response. Per [[TG-QRY-1]] the graph evaluates against its current persisted state; this timestamp is the moment the call was answered.

output.description: Per-query output shape; constrained by the discriminated `allOf` branch matching `query`.

nextCursor.description: Keyset continuation cursor per [TG-QRY-6]; `null` on the last page and for non-paginated (shape-fixed) queries.

schema.title: GraphErrorResponse
schema.description: Shared error envelope for the Verana Graph traversal and faceted-search APIs, per [TG-ERR-1]. Every non-2xx response of either API MUST validate against this schema.

code.description: Machine-readable error class per [TG-ERR-1] — the only field programmatic consumers need.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Implementation-defined wording; MUST NOT be required for programmatic dispatch.

search_request_SnippetSelectorDid.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `Did` surface groups. Default set: service, operator, corporation, endpoints.

service.description: VS-level identity from the ServiceCredential: pattern, name, type, description, logo.

operator.description: Operative ORG-or-PERSONA identity the trust chain rests on: kind, name, logo, countryCode, registryId, address.

corporation.description: Owner Corporation identity and trust signals: id, deposit, slash history.

endpoints.description: The DID Document's declared service endpoints ({ id, type, serviceEndpoint }).

ecosystems.description: Ecosystem entries controlled by this DID, each with per-role participant counts and its owned schemas ({ id, title, archived, participants }).

participations.description: The DID's ACTIVE Participant entries: { total, ecosystemCount, byRole, entries[{ id, role, credentialSchemaId, schemaTitle, ecosystemId }] }.

credentials.description: Non-ECS VTCs presented by the DID: { total, entries[{ id, credentialSchemaId, schemaTitle, ecosystemId, attributes }] }. ECS credentials never appear here (see the service / operator groups).

search_request_SnippetSelectorEcosystem.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `Ecosystem` surface groups. Default set: corporation, stats, didCard.

corporation.description: Controlling Corporation identity and trust signals via `Ecosystem.corporationId` (same field set as the Did-surface corporation group).

stats.description: Entity-table counters: participants (per-role map), issuedCredentials, verifiedCredentials.

governance.description: Inline `egf` summary { version, activeSince, documents[] } — metadata only, no bodies; null when no GF published.

schemas.description: Owned schemas ({ id, title, archived, participants }), one entry per `Ecosystem.credentialSchemaIds[]` member.

didCard.description: The controller DID rendered as a card: { did, trusted, isTrustExpired, service, operator }.

search_request_SnippetSelectorCorporatio.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `Corporation` surface groups. Default set: trust, didCard.

trust.description: { policyAddress, deposit, slashedEvents, lastSlashedAtTime, slashedValue } from the Corporation record.

governance.description: Inline `cgf` summary — same shape as the Ecosystem governance group; null when no GF published.

ecosystems.description: Controlled Ecosystems: { total, entries[{ id, archived }] }.

dids.description: Owned DIDs per the VPR DID ownership invariant: { total, entries[{ did, trusted, isTrustExpired }] } — unbounded, truncation escape applies.

didCard.description: The Corporation's own DID rendered as a card: { did, trusted, isTrustExpired, service, operator }.

search_request_SnippetSelectorCredential.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `CredentialSchema` surface groups. Default set: schema, ecosystem. Not DID-bound: no didCard.

schema.description: { type, digestSri, title, description } — title/description from the loaded body (null when the body declares none).

ecosystem.description: { id, archived } of the owning Ecosystem (exactly one, per [TG-EDGE-3]).

stats.description: Entity-table counters: participants (per-role map), issuedCredentials, verifiedCredentials.

body.description: The full loaded JSON Schema body, verbatim. Opt-in purely for wire weight; never null once the record exists ([TG-DEREF-2]).

search_request_SnippetSelectorServiceEnd.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `ServiceEndpoint` surface groups. Default set: didCard (the only group).

didCard.description: The owning DID (`didId`) rendered as a card: { did, trusted, isTrustExpired, service, operator }.

search_request_Scalar.description: anyOf, not oneOf: a JSON integer matches both `number` and `integer`, so a oneOf over both branches rejects every integer.

search_request_FilterValue.description: A bare scalar (interpreted as `eq`) or an operator object. Operators map to the [TG-FCT-3] operator column; not every operator applies to every field — spec text governs which operators are valid per field.

in.description: Match any of the listed values.

range.description: Numeric / temporal range. At least one bound MUST be provided.

contains.description: Set / array containment of a single value.

containsAny.description: Set / array containment of any value in the list.

search_response_Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.

search_response_Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for `Corporation.policyAddress` and for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account; NOT used as a primary key.

search_response_Hit.description: A single ranked hit. The `snippet` shape is discriminated by `type` per the per-surface variants in `#/$defs`.

id.description: Primary key of the hit. DID for `type = Did`, integer VPR id for `Corporation` / `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`, string id for `ServiceEndpoint`.

score.description: Final ranking score combining the [TG-FCT-4] lexical score with the [TG-FCT-5] trust signals. Absolute scale is implementation-defined.

snippet.description: Per-surface result-card payload; constrained by the discriminated `allOf` branch matching `type`.

highlights.description: Pre-rendered highlight fragments (e.g. with `...` markers around matched terms). Optional and implementation-defined.

search_response_DidSnippet.description: A `Did` hit snippet: the always-present [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] field groups selected by the request's `snippet` projection ([TG-FCT-6c]; default set: `service`, `operator`, `corporation`, `endpoints`). An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`. Within a returned group, a field with no value MUST be present with value `null`, not omitted. Implementations MAY surface additional fields.

isCorporation.description: `true` iff the DID is the current `did` of a `Corporation` entry. Powers the Corporation badge and the `Did.isCorporation` filter.

isEcosystem.description: `true` iff the DID is the current `did` of at least one `Ecosystem` entry (equivalently: the `ecosystems` group, when requested, is non-empty). Powers the Ecosystem badge and the `Did.isEcosystem` filter.

service.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `service` group; `null` when the DID presents no `ServiceCredential`. Present iff selected (default set).

operator.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `operator` group; `null` when the trust chain is incomplete. Present iff selected (default set).

corporation.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `corporation` group; never `null`. Present iff selected (default set).

endpoints.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `endpoints` group — the DID's `ServiceEndpoint` records (the non-`LinkedVerifiablePresentation` `services[]` entries of the DID Document); `[]` when the DID Document declares no such entry. Present iff selected (default set).

ecosystems.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `ecosystems` group — the `Ecosystem` entries whose current `did` is this DID; `[]` when none (non-empty iff `isEcosystem`). Present iff selected (opt-in).

participations.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `participations` group — the DID's ACTIVE `Participant` entries. Present iff selected (opt-in).

credentials.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `credentials` group — the non-ECS VTCs presented by the DID. Present iff selected (opt-in).

search_response_DidSnippetService.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `service` group: the VS-level identity asserted by the `ServiceCredential`. The group is `null` (not this object) when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

pattern.description: Architecture pattern (`Did.pattern`); non-null whenever a ServiceCredential exists.

description.description: `ServiceCredential.description`, optionally truncated for card use (truncation ends at a character boundary and is flagged with a trailing `…`).

search_response_DidSnippetOperator.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `operator` group: the operative ORG-or-PERSONA identity the VS's trust chain rests on (Pattern A: self; Pattern B: issuer), per the [TG-FCT-3] derivation. The group is `null` (not this object) when the trust chain is incomplete.

logoUri.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.logoUri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarUri`; `null` for a Persona without avatar.

logoDigestSri.description: Paired `OrganizationCredential.logoDigestSri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarDigestSri`; `null` under the same conditions as `logoUri`.

registryId.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.registryId`; `null` when the operator is a Persona.

address.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.address`; `null` when the operator is a Persona.

search_response_DidSnippetCorporation.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `corporation` group: a Corporation's identity and trust signals, anchored on the hit's corporation binding — `Did.corporationId` (the owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant) on the `Did` surface, `Ecosystem.corporationId` (the controlling Corporation) on the `Ecosystem` surface. Never `null` as a group: `id` is always known; the other fields are `null` only while the referenced Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

id.description: Stable `uint64` id of the referenced Corporation (`Did.corporationId` / `Ecosystem.corporationId`). Never null.

deposit.description: Referenced `Corporation.deposit` (Coin string); `null` only while the Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

slashedEvents.description: Referenced `Corporation.slashedEvents` (`0` when never slashed); `null` only while the Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

lastSlashedAtTime.description: Referenced `Corporation.lastSlashedAtTime`; `null` when never slashed, or while the Corporation record is not yet materialised.

slashedValue.description: Referenced `Corporation.slashedValue` (Coin string); `null` when never slashed, or while the Corporation record is not yet materialised.

search_response_DidSnippetEndpoint.description: One declared service endpoint of the DID Document, per [TG-FCT-6b] `endpoints`.

id.description: DID Document service entry id (DID-relative URL).

serviceEndpoint.description: Endpoint value preserved verbatim per DID-CORE (URI string or object).

search_response_ParticipantRole.description: Participant role per the `Participant` entity table.

search_response_DidSnippetEcosystem.description: One `Ecosystem` entry whose current `did` is the hit DID, per [TG-FCT-6b] `ecosystems`. Archived entries appear with their `archived` flag — these are references from the hit, not direct Ecosystem-surface hits, so the [TG-FCT-2] gates do not apply to them.

participants.description: `Ecosystem.participants` — the Ecosystem's global per-role participant counts.

schemas.description: One entry per member of `Ecosystem.credentialSchemaIds[]`; `[]` when the Ecosystem owns no schema.

search_response_DidSnippetParticipations.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `participations` group: the DID's ACTIVE `Participant` entries (non-ACTIVE entries never reach the search surface, per [TG-ACT-1]; the full lifecycle view is traversal query A7). `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total`, `ecosystemCount`, and `byRole` always reflect the untruncated population.

total.description: Count of the DID's ACTIVE Participant entries.

ecosystemCount.description: Count of distinct `Participant.ecosystemId` values among them.

byRole.description: Map role → count over the same entries; `{}` when `total = 0`.

entries.description: One entry per ACTIVE Participant; `[]` when `total = 0`.

id.description: Stable VPR `Participant.id` — the G1 traversal anchor.

schemaTitle.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

search_response_DidSnippetCredentials.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `credentials` group: the non-ECS Verifiable Trust Credentials presented by the DID (`Vtc` records reachable via `Did —REFERENCES_VP→ LVP —CONTAINS_VTC→ Vtc`). ECS credentials (ServiceCredential / OrganizationCredential / PersonaCredential) MUST NOT appear here — they are projected by the `service` and `operator` groups. A presented VTC is by definition held by the DID (no role field). `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total` always reflects the untruncated population.

total.description: Count of distinct `Vtc` records presented by the DID.

id.description: The VTC's credential id (`Vtc.id`) — the B1 / B2 traversal anchor.

schemaTitle.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

attributes.description: The credential's `credentialSubject` claims verbatim, minus the subject `id` (the hit's own DID); `null` when the implementation has not fetched the VP body per [TG-DEREF-3] (the fetch is RECOMMENDED).

search_response_SchemaRef.description: Owned-schema reference: the shared item shape of the `Did`-surface `ecosystems[].schemas` and the `Ecosystem`-surface `schemas` group.

title.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

search_response_DidCard.description: [TG-FCT-6b] shared `didCard` group: the surface's bound DID rendered as a result card. Never `null` (the bound DID always exists as a `Did` record); `trusted` / `isTrustExpired` describe the bound DID and never gate the hit ([TG-FCT-2] non-propagation).

service.description: Same shape and null conditions as the `Did`-surface `service` group.

operator.description: Same shape and null conditions as the `Did`-surface `operator` group.

search_response_GovernanceFrameworkSumma.description: Inline governance-framework summary (`cgf` / `egf` per [TG-DEREF-2a] / [TG-DEREF-2b]): active version, activation time, and document metadata — never document bodies. `activeSince` is required-present per the [TG-FCT-6b] null-not-omitted rule (`null` when the upstream inline object omits it), even though the persisted entity-table shape writes it as optional.

version.description: Active GF version (integer, per the indexer's inline `cgf` / `egf` surfacing).

search_response_EntityStats.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `stats` group: the entity-table counters of the hit (`Ecosystem` or `CredentialSchema`).

search_response_EcosystemSnippet.description: An `Ecosystem` hit snippet: the [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] Ecosystem-surface groups selected by the projection (default set: `corporation`, `stats`, `didCard`). An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`.

did.description: The Ecosystem's DID (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.did`; MAY be shared across Ecosystem entries — the key remains `id`).

corporation.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `corporation` group via `Ecosystem.corporationId` — same field set as the `Did`-surface group; never `null`. Present iff selected (default set).

governance.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `governance` group — the inline `egf` summary; `null` when the Ecosystem has not yet published any GF. Present iff selected (opt-in).

schemas.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `schemas` group; `[]` when the Ecosystem owns no schema. Present iff selected (opt-in).

didCard.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `didCard` group — the controller DID (`Ecosystem.did`) as a card. Present iff selected (default set).

search_response_CorporationTrust.description: [TG-FCT-6b] Corporation `trust` group: on-chain signing identity and trust signals from the Corporation record.

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`).

search_response_CorporationEcosystems.description: [TG-FCT-6b] Corporation `ecosystems` group: the Ecosystems this Corporation controls.

search_response_CorporationDids.description: [TG-FCT-6b] Corporation `dids` group: the DIDs this Corporation owns per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Unbounded — `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total` always reflects the untruncated population.

search_response_CorporationSnippet.description: A `Corporation` hit snippet: the [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] Corporation-surface groups selected by the projection (default set: `trust`, `didCard`). An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`.

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

did.description: The Corporation's own declared DID (mirrors VPR `Corporation.did`).

trust.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `trust` group; never `null`. Present iff selected (default set).

governance.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `governance` group — the inline `cgf` summary; `null` when the Corporation has not yet published any GF. Present iff selected (opt-in).

didCard.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `didCard` group — the Corporation's own DID as a card. Present iff selected (default set).

search_response_CredentialSchemaMeta.description: [TG-FCT-6b] CredentialSchema `schema` group: record metadata plus the loaded body's title and description.

title.description: `title` of the loaded body; `null` when the body declares none.

description.description: `description` of the loaded body; `null` when the body declares none.

search_response_CredentialSchemaSnippet.description: A `CredentialSchema` hit snippet: the [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] CredentialSchema-surface groups selected by the projection (default set: `schema`, `ecosystem`). Not DID-bound: no `didCard`. An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`.

ecosystem.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `ecosystem` group — the owning Ecosystem (exactly one, per [TG-EDGE-3]). Present iff selected (default set).

body.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `body` group — the full loaded JSON Schema body, verbatim; never `null` ([TG-DEREF-2] loads and digest-validates the body before the record exists). Present iff selected (opt-in, wire weight).

search_response_ServiceEndpointSnippet.description: A `ServiceEndpoint` hit snippet: the [TG-FCT-6a] core — which includes `type` and the verbatim `serviceEndpoint`, the payload of the surface — plus the `didCard` group when selected (default set).

didId.description: The owning DID (the `Did` of the `EXPOSES_SERVICE` edge), per [TG-FCT-6a].

serviceEndpoint.description: Endpoint value preserved verbatim per DID-CORE (URI string or object).

didCard.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `didCard` group — the owning DID as a card. Present iff selected (default set).

search_response_FacetAggregation.description: Per-value count for one filter field. Implementations MAY truncate to a top-N for high-cardinality facets.

value.description: anyOf, not oneOf: a JSON integer matches both `number` and a hypothetical `integer` branch, so a oneOf over both rejects every integer facet value (same rationale as the request schema's `Scalar`).

traverse_request_TraversalQueryId.description: Canonical traversal query id from [TG-QRY-3]. A1–A7 DID-rooted, B1–B2 credential-rooted, C1–C3 ecosystem-rooted, D1–D2 schema-rooted, E1–E3 corporation-rooted, F1 path (SHOULD), G1 Participant-rooted (validator chain).

traverse_request_Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account and for `Corporation.policyAddress`.

did.description: The credential's subject/holder DID. `EcsCredential` records are keyed `(subjectDid, id)`; a `Vtc` is matched by `credentialId` among the VTCs presented by this DID.

credentialId.description: The credential `id` — either an `EcsCredential.id` or a `Vtc.id`. The graph dispatches on the actual record type internally.

ecosystemId.description: Stable VPR id of the Ecosystem.

credentialSchemaId.description: Optional schema filter to scope to one of the Ecosystem's owned schemas (C2 only).
Stable VPR id of the CredentialSchema.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

id.description: Primary key of the referenced entity. DID for `type = Did`, integer VPR id for `Corporation` / `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema` / `Participant`, string id for `EcsCredential` / `Vtc` / `LinkedVerifiablePresentation` / `ServiceEndpoint`.

participantId.description: Stable VPR id of the leaf `Participant` from which to walk the validator chain upward to the `ECOSYSTEM`-role root (mirrors VPR `Participant.id`). G1 only.

traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.

traverse_response_Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account and for `Corporation.policyAddress`; NOT used as a primary key (Corporation, Ecosystem, CredentialSchema, and Participant primary keys are all `uint64` VPR ledger ids).

traverse_response_DigestSri.description: Subresource Integrity digest in the standard `algo-base64` form.

traverse_response_Pattern.description: Architecture pattern per VS-REQ-3 / VS-REQ-4 (A: self-issued; B: delegated); null when the DID presents no ServiceCredential (untrusted DID).

traverse_response_GovernanceFramework.description: Active Governance Framework (CGF on a Corporation, EGF on an Ecosystem). Mirrors the indexer-side `GovernanceFramework` shape.

traverse_response_DidRef.description: Minimal Did reference. `isTrustExpired` is the [[TG-ACT-3]] visibility flag; per [[TG-QRY-3]] every entity reference MUST carry the visibility flags applicable to its type, and it is always computable as `expiresAtTime` non-null and `< now`.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

did.description: The Corporation's own declared DID (mirrors VPR `Corporation.did`). Identity only — the DID's trust state lives on the `Did` node (A1 / referential lookup).

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`). Globally unique across all Corporation entries. MAY be backed by any signing primitive (single key, multisig, Cosmos SDK group policy, …).

did.description: The Ecosystem's DID (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.did`). Per VPR, several Ecosystem entries MAY share one DID — the primary key remains `id`. Identity only; trust state lives on the `Did` node.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the Corporation that controls this Ecosystem (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.corporation_id`).

traverse_response_ParticipantRef.description: Minimal Participant reference. `state` carries the current lifecycle state; non-`ACTIVE` records are retained while referenced per [[TG-ACT-1]] and are returned by traversal with their state. `validatorParticipantId` anchors the `VALIDATED_BY: Participant → Participant` edge (the parent node in the permission tree); it is `null` if and only if `role = ECOSYSTEM` (the chain root, per [[TG-EDGE-4]]).

didId.description: The DID this Participant entry refers to (envelope-derived at ingestion). Identity only; trust state lives on the `Did` node.

vsOperator.description: `null` until a VS Operator Authorization has been granted for this entry.

validatorParticipantId.description: Stable VPR id of the validator Participant (parent in the permission tree). `null` iff `role = ECOSYSTEM`; non-negative integer otherwise. The graph persists the value as received from the indexer; the role-conditional rule is enforced upstream at the indexer's ingress.

subjectDid.description: The credential's subject/holder DID — part of the `(subjectDid, id)` record key.

id.description: The credential `id` — part of the `(subjectDid, id)` record key.

digestJCS.description: Informational: the credential's JCS digest, recomputed and ledger-verified by the indexer per [IDX-VT-EVAL-1].

issuedAtTime.description: Effective issuance time: the `created` timestamp of the credential's ledger Digest entry.

validUntil.description: `null` for open-ended credentials, per the entity table (`timestamp | null`).

traverse_response_CredentialAnyRef.description: Either an EcsCredential or a Vtc record. The graph dispatches on the actual stored shape.

traverse_response_A1Output.description: A1 — Trust summary. Mirrors the trust-core fields the indexer surfaces under `/v4/verifiable-trust/resolve` for this DID, plus the graph-level `lastObservedAtTime`.

expiresAtTime.description: Earliest trust-flipping boundary per [IDX-VT-EVAL-2]; `null` when no boundary exists (never trust-expires until an upstream re-evaluation).

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.

traverse_response_A2Output.description: A2 — Governing chain. Owning Corporation and the deduplicated set of Ecosystems whose schemas the DID participates in.

traverse_response_A3Output.description: A3 — Service endpoints (DID Document `service[]` excluding LinkedVerifiablePresentation entries).

traverse_response_A4Output.description: A4 — Linked VPs and their contained VTCs.

traverse_response_A5Output.description: A5 — Held credentials (DID is subject), each enriched with issuer/schema/ecosystem context.

traverse_response_A6Output.description: A6 — Issued credentials (DID is issuer). Both EcsCredential and Vtc records, each enriched with subject/schema/ecosystem context.

traverse_response_A7Output.description: A7 — Participants by role, each accompanied by its schema and ecosystem context.

traverse_response_B1Output.description: B1 — Issuer recovery for a credential surfaced in the graph (per [[TG-INGEST-6]]).

traverse_response_B2Output.description: B2 — Holder recovery for a credential surfaced in the graph.

traverse_response_C1Output.description: C1 — Schemas owned by the Ecosystem (1:1 schema → ecosystem).

traverse_response_RoleToDidsOutput.description: C2 / D2 — Participating DIDs grouped by role. Each role key MAY be omitted when no participants of that role exist.

traverse_response_C3Output.description: C3 — Ecosystem Governance Framework summary; document bodies are surfaced only if locally fetched.

traverse_response_D1Output.description: D1 — Credentials based on the schema (both ECS credentials and Vtcs).

traverse_response_E1Output.description: E1 — DIDs owned by the Corporation.

traverse_response_E2Output.description: E2 — Ecosystems controlled by the Corporation.

traverse_response_E3Output.description: E3 — Corporation Governance Framework summary; document bodies are surfaced only if locally fetched.

oneOf.description: F1 — Shortest trust path. Ordered sequence of `(node, edge)` steps; the final step's `edge` MAY be omitted when the path terminates at the target node.
No path exists between `from` and `to` in the current graph.

traverse_response_G1Output.description: G1 — Validator chain. Ordered `ParticipantRef[]` from **root to leaf inclusive**: the first element has `role = ECOSYSTEM` and `validatorParticipantId = null` (the permission-tree root for the input Participant's Ecosystem; see [[TG-EDGE-4]]); the last element is the input Participant itself. Every element's `ecosystemId` MUST be identical (a validator chain never crosses Ecosystem boundaries). If the input Participant is itself the ECOSYSTEM root, this is a 1-element array containing only the input.
